full_judgment: 38. In the case of Abdul Hamid vs Abul Hossain Mir, reported in 35 DLR 295 his Lordship held that "Presumption of Khatian loses its weight with the passage of time and that the entries in the subsequent khatian would be more acceptable to a Court than the entries in the earlier Khatian."
